The system enforces a dual-layered retrieval architecture: first, documents are scored using RRF with BM25 weights, then re-ranked using domain priors. This ensures that high-quality, relevant content is prioritized while maintaining robustness against irrelevant or noisy sources. The corpus gate acts as a probabilistic filter, ensuring only valid inferences propagate to higher layers. In GSE, this translates into a structured reasoning pipeline where each retrieved claim contributes to a dynamic model of game state. The failure mode arises when domain priors are misapplied or when the gate fails to validate claims, leading to cascading errors in downstream reasoning.
